message.content: {"caption":"Workflow showing how skill revision is separated from benchmark evaluation.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram. The “Available inputs” box contains Task T, workspace W, initial skill S₀, and frozen agent π. A right-pointing arrow leads to “Stub evolution,” which contains paired audits, PACE, and the Task-Compiled Verifier. The arrow from stub evolution to “Evaluation conditions” is labeled “terminates”; that box lists No skill, Curated skill, and Evolved skill. A right-pointing arrow labeled “evaluate” leads to “Post-evolution evaluation,” where the Benchmark verifier assigns task reward. “During evolution” is shown above the stub-evolution stage, and “After evolution” above the post-evolution evaluation. A red X marks the statement that the benchmark verifier, test content, and task reward are unavailable during evolution.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
